finite_arithmetic.scope: Finite full-message reference comparisons and one selected prefix. No prefix-search minimality, success probability or global implementation proof.

documented_example.scope: Imported finite helper only; CLI --selftest equivalence searches are not run.

declared_accounting.scope: Declared rational ledger including the scan allowance in all four checked widths; storage arithmetic includes advice. Not a scan execution receipt or independent proof of the 717-operation allowance. ledger(32/40) has no mixed-key argument and prices its default profile, not the 32m/40m experiments. Selection/loss uses floats, not interval-certified probabilities.

dispatch.scope: Stubbed dispatch. The limit is trial_id < cutoff, not list position, unique-ID count or a per-request maximum. No hash search ran.

attempt_counters.scope: Stubbed wrapper behavior. Zeroed counters after Halt do not mean zero physical work; normal counters still omit speculative/recovery kernel calls.

synthetic_grouping.scope: Four artificial constant maps, two group sizes, four-main-batch caps. Not cryptographic collision witnesses.
